title: Typefu action
description: One selection bar action for Typefu. Typefu ignores keys it doesn't know, so newer files still load in older versions where possible.

schemaVersion.description: Format version. Only changes for breaking changes.

id.description: Kebab-case name that never changes, like rot13 or search-github. The file is actions/<id>.json.

version.description: The action's own version. Bump it when you change the action.

minAppVersion.description: The oldest Typefu version that can run the action.

summary.description: One sentence about what the action does.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name, like magnifyingglass.

script.description: url: a URL with {text} (URL-encoded) or {text | pipe}. javaScript: code using text, or function run(text). shell: zsh with the text on stdin and in $EXPANDER_TEXT. appleScript: code using selectedText. shortcut: the Shortcut's name.

output.description: What happens with the result. URL actions use none.

timeout.description: Seconds before shell, AppleScript and Shortcut actions are stopped.

requirements.description: When the action is offered. Leave out keys you don't need.

permissions.description: Reserved for capabilities beyond text work, like network. Shown to the user before installing.
